Ivy: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 19. We need owners, Jira tickets, and RACI entries for the remediation list. Two of these failures look like the same underlying race.

Marcus: I'll own the race condition fix and open a ticket today. Plan: repro -> hotfix -> canary.

InfraBot: Created JIRA RDX-3177: "fix: leader-election race causing double-writes" assigned to Marcus. https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RDX-3177

Zoe: I'll own the runbook update and a short chaos test. Add R:Marcus, A:Ivy, C:Zoe, I:platform-oncall in the ticket. Also set recurrence_count=2.

Marcus: RDX-3177 updated with RACI and a short repro in comments. ETA for repro: 2024-09-10.

Ivy: Process decision: PM closes -> ticket created within 48h -> owner assigned within 72h -> canary plan attached. Also we should mark this as a dependent task of RDX-3000 (resilience epic) but keep it small.

Zoe: Will attach chaos test PR and canary checklist before rollout. Target dates in ticket: repro 2024-09-10, canary 2024-09-17.

Ivy: Action recap (copy to ticket comments): Marcus (R) RDX-3177 repro+fix due 2024-09-10; Zoe (R) runbook+chaos test due 2024-09-14; Ivy (A) sign-off before full rollout 2024-09-20. Keep updates in RDX-3177. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
